summary: Gilat Satellite Networks Ltd. filed a Form 6-K (report of foreign issuer under Rule 13a-16) containing a press release announcing the expansion of its portfolio for tactical unmanned platforms, including the new Viper Ka-band ESA antenna, for display at Eurosatory 2026. This is a routine product announcement and trade show participation, not a special situation. No corporate transaction, activist campaign, strategic review, or other special-situation event is disclosed. The filing is a standard current report under the 1934 Act.
